stable9b.name: Qwen 3.5 9B Q6_K

geometry._comment: Read from the GGUF header (qwen35.*). HYBRID attention/SSM architecture: full_attention_interval=4 means only 1 layer in 4 holds a KV cache; the rest are SSM layers with fixed-size state. Counting all 32 blocks overestimates KV by 4x.

stable9b.note: Stable. No MTP: the GGUF does not carry nextn_predict_layers.

experimental27b.name: Qwen 3.8 27B UD-Q3_K_XL (unsloth)

geometry._comment: 65 blocks = 64 real layers + 1 nextn (MTP) layer. With full_attention_interval=4 that leaves 16 layers holding a KV cache. Measured on a 16 GB GPU: with vision at 64K it uses 15.2 GB.

experimental27b.note: Unsloth Q3. Ships MTP: enabled automatically on CUDA when VRAM allows.
